// want: analyzer "text-markers" reads "max_lines", not declared
// want: x: Params is called on holder, not a Context
// with: pass
package x

type wrapped struct{ pass.Context }

func run(ctx pass.Context) {
	holder := wrapped{ctx}
	_ = holder.Params("text-markers").Int("max_lines", 1)
}
